title: General Conditions of Entry – TCS London Marathon
claims: Entry channels covered by the conditions are charity entries, direct sales, ballot and prize draw.

Entrants must be 18 years of age or over and sufficiently fit and healthy; the entry is personal, and swapping, selling or transferring the place or letting another person wear the bib is strictly prohibited.

Prohibited items include any artificial aid or wheeled device and any pets or animals; in the wheelchair section a team of four may assist, with a maximum of two members pushing at any one time, and the wheelchair may not have gears or any mechanical, powered or electronic aid.

Organisers may refuse entry or stop participation for alcohol or drugs use, injury or illness, late arrival, or insufficient progress to meet event timelines; only those finishing before the official cut-off are eligible for a medal and results.

Using false documents, borrowing another person's GFA or Championship time, falsifying entry information, or entering the ballot more than once can annul results and lead to a ban of up to five years.
The bib with built-in timing device must be collected in person at the Event Running Show at ExCeL London in the four days before the Event.
Fees are non-refundable; withdrawal does not entitle to a refund, though LMEL may at its discretion permit a guaranteed entry for the following year; an unused charity place reverts to the charity.
